India Joins French-Led Sixth-Generation Fighter Jet Program

India has joined the Future Combat Air System (FCAS) program, a sixth-generation fighter jet initiative led by France. This move aims to ensure the Indian Air Force does not fall behind technologically. The decision positions India within a European consortium focused on developing advanced combat air capabilities.
